'''Dron''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Admiral/Legends|admiral]] in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. In the early stages of the conflict, he served with [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi Generals]] [[Keelyvine Reus]] and [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]] during an expedition to the vital [[Agriworld/Legends|agriworld]] of [[Ukio/Legends|Ukio]]. The [[Planet/Legends|world]] was of major importance to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], as it supplied [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] to the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] as well as to the entire [[Abrion sector/Legends|Abrion sector]], and the expedition was tasked with securing the planet's allegiance in order to aid the war effort. Dron and his [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] held station over Ukio at [[General/Legends|General]] Reus's behest, and watched for any suspected [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] activity. Soon, Dron's men detected a lone enemy [[Unidentified Lucrehulk-class battleship (Ukio)|battleship]] approaching the planet.

The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] investigated and discovered that the enemy was deploying a dark, cloudy substance that adhered to Ukio's [[Planetary shield/Legends|planetary shield]]. Fisto was able to collect data, which he transmitted to Dron, and the admiral subsequently had his men analyze the material. [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Pharl McQuarrie/Legends|Pharl McQuarrie]] determined that it was [[Moorja/Legends|Moorjan]] soil, which was electromagnetic and photo-sensitive. Essentially, the cloud would leave Ukio's crops in perpetual night. The admiral then worked with General Reus to avert the disaster, and although Ukio was [[Battle of Ukio|successfully defended]] by the Republic, it was later purchased by [[Magistrate/Legends|Magistrate]] [[Passel Argente/Legends|Passel Argente]] of the Confederacy.

==Biography==
===Onward to Ukio===
{{Quote|We have entered the Ukio system, General Reus.''"<br />"''Thank you, Admiral Dron. Have the frigates form a sentry line. Go to yellow alert.|Dron and General Reus|<ref name="aoi" />}}
[[File:Dron.png|thumb|left|175px|Admiral Dron]]
Dron was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]-wide conflict between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], Dron served as an [[Admiral/Legends|admiral]], and was assigned to work with [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi Generals]] [[Keelyvine Reus]] and [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]]. Reus's [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] learner, [[Tyzen Xebec]], also served in the task force. In the early stages of the Clone Wars, a [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] commanded by Reus, consisting of a [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] and two [[Consular-class cruiser (Charger c70 retrofit)/Legends|''Consular''-class frigates]], was dispatched to [[Ukio/Legends|Ukio]]&mdash;a vital [[Agriworld/Legends|agriworld]] that supplied the Republic with [[Foodstuff/Legends|victuals]] for its [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] units.<ref name="aoi" />

Dron informed Reus when the fleet entered the [[Star system/Legends|system]], and Reus in turn instructed the admiral to have the [[Frigate/Legends|frigates]] form a sentry line, before initiating a yellow alert. Later, Dron joined Reus, Fisto, and Xebec for a briefing from the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] provided those gathered with the background of their mission. In addition to being vital to the Republic effort, Ukio also supplied the entire [[Abrion sector/Legends|Abrion sector]], as well as the [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] along the [[Triellus Trade Route/Legends|Triellus Trade Route]], making it a holding of great significance. Prior to the war, Ukio had seceded from the Republic, but [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Master [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] had been able to keep the act from being completed by calling in a personal entreaty.<ref name="aoi" />

However, the citizenry of Ukio remained divided, and Kenobi warned that the situation was ripe for interference from the Confederacy. Though the planet was defended by a powerful [[Planetary shield/Legends|planetary shield]], Kenobi aired his concerns to Dron and the others: he was puzzled by the fact that no Confederate fleets had been detected within the vicinity, as [[Clone Intelligence/Legends|Clone Intelligence]] was sure Ukio was attracting enemy attention. Windu ordered the Generals to perform reconnaissance on the planet itself, while Dron and the fleet were to hold station above Ukio.<ref name="aoi" />

===A disturbance===
{{Quote|We have made some findings.|Admiral Dron|<ref name="aoi" />}}
Dron summoned Reus and Fisto when the [[Ukian satellite network]] detected a disturbance on the other side of the planet. The Ukian data was quickly resolved, leading to the discovery of a Confederate [[Unidentified Lucrehulk-class battleship (Ukio)|''Lucrehulk''-class battleship]] over the horizon. Dron quickly identified the [[Lucrehulk-class battleship/Legends|ship]] as a lightly armed [[Carrier/Legends|carrier]], and Reus found the presence of a single [[Starship/Legends|ship]] to be suspect. The Jedi determined that it might be a Confederate ploy to lure the Republic fleet to the other side of the planet, as the lone [[Battleship/Legends|battleship]] could not hope to damage Ukio's planetary [[Deflector shield/Legends|shield]]. Reus ordered Dron to continue to hold station at his current position while she and Fisto performed reconnaissance duties in their [[Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|Delta-7B ''Aethersprite''-class light interceptors]].<ref name="aoi" />

[[File:ReusFistoDronBriefing.png|thumb|right|200px|Generals Reus and Fisto, as well as Dron, listen to a briefing by Captain McQuarrie.]]
The Jedi discovered that the battleship was deploying modified [[Seismic tank/Legends|seismic tanks]], which were in turn unleashing a black, cloudy substance onto Ukio's planetary shield. Fisto was able to run a diagnostic of the material and send the data back to Dron. The admiral then forwarded the material to the other ships of the fleet, while the Confederate craft began to [[Jammer/Legends|jam]] most frequencies, making it difficult for Reus to communicate with Dron. However, [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Pharl McQuarrie/Legends|Pharl McQuarrie]], who served under Dron, had made a discovery as the Jedi made their way back to the [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]]. By the [[Time/Legends|time]] Reus and Fisto had made it back to the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]], Dron was able to set up a conference with McQuarrie, who had discovered that the substance was in fact the electromagnetic soil of [[Moorja/Legends|Moorja]] which clung to the Ukian planetary shield. Although the soil did not damage the shield, it was photo-reactive, meaning that it moved in tandem as the planet [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] its [[Star/Legends|sun]]&mdash;essentially, it would continually cause an eclipse on Ukio, perpetually blocking out all sunlight and preventing the survival of the crops.<ref name="aoi" />

Dron and the two Jedi opened communications with the most senior official on Ukio, the [[Ukian/Legends|Ukian]] [[Unidentified liege|liege]], and Reus informed him of the situation. He was furious, and urged the Jedi to find a solution, as the loss of any more sunlight could potentially ruin the crops. The [[Overliege|liege]] came to the conclusion that they could lower the shields, but Reus strongly cautioned against such an action, as it was likely precisely what the Confederacy wanted. Captain McQuarrie informed Dron and the others that opening the shield briefly would scatter the substance to the Ukian winds, and Reus relented, advising the liege to create an opening in his shields within fifteen [[Standard minute/Legends|minutes]], for as short a time as possible, to dissipate the cloud of soil. Dron was ordered by Reus to move the fleet to [[Battle of Ukio|engage]] the Confederate battleship, in synchronicity with the scheduled lowering of the shield. It was Reus's hope that they would be able to prevent any Confederates from breaching the shield while it was disabled. He was also reminded by the Jedi that they would not be able to communicate due to the level of jamming taking place, so their timing would be critical.<ref name="aoi" />

The ploy worked, although the Confederate forces led by the enemy mastermind "[[Doctor (tactical droid)|Doctor]]" managed to land on Ukio and cause a considerable amount of havoc. The enemy battleship was eventually destroyed by Dron's forces, allowing Reus to land on the planet and assist Xebec in eliminating the enemy threat. The Republic won a tactical victory, repelling the Confederate efforts to render Ukio useless. However, the continual turmoil surrounding the planet brought Ukian stocks down severely, allowing [[Magistrate/Legends|Magistrate]] [[Passel Argente/Legends|Passel Argente]] to buy a controlling interest, bringing the planet under Confederate control and forcing the Republic to depart.<ref name="aoi" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|We've confirmed the substance to be soil from the Moorja badlands, Admiral. It's an electro-static compound with photoreactive properties.''"<br />"''In plain Basic, Captain?|Pharl McQuarrie and Dron|<ref name="aoi" />}}
When faced with an incoming hostile such as the ''Lucrehulk''-class battleship that approached Ukio by itself shortly before the battle at Ukio, Dron was able to quickly identify the ship's type and its level of armament. He also had little understanding of complex scientific terms, and was baffled when Captain McQuarrie provided a detail description of the properties of Moorjan soil. Dron had [[Color/Legends|black]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]], although his temples were graying, and also possessed brown [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and dark skin.<ref name="aoi" />

==Behind the scenes==
Dron first appeared in the [[Star Wars comic books|webcomic]] ''[[The Clone Wars: Act on Instinct]]'', which was written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] and published in [[2009]]. The [[Star Wars comic books|comic's]] art was done by [[Tom Hodges]], [[Grant Gould]], [[Jeffery Carlisle]], and [[Daniel Falconer]]. Dron was introduced in the fifth installment of the comic.
